# lean_proof: another proof of the same statement

A node's first Lean proof is its `lean_decl` (`lean/proof`). More proofs, usually from proposals, are each one
of these tests: a theorem in its own file with **exactly** the same statement (definitional equality is not
enough), a different proof term, and only standard or declared axioms. Several proofs of one theorem make a
mistake in any single one less likely to matter; the `approach` text says what each proof's idea is.

<!-- tests:begin (generated by `dagtool readmes`; edit the test docstrings, not this table) -->
| Test | What it checks | A pass grants |
|---|---|---|
| [`lean_proof/independent_proof`](independent_proof.py) | One more Lean proof of the statement the node already proves. | Proved, or proved_modulo the assumption nodes it uses. |
